summary: Installed an Orchestrator-specific secondary Project Map and a read-only Kit-compatible helper. Production RepositoryContextHelperProvider now consumes the real repository startup profile without fallback; smoke cases enforce bounded startup/review/project-map retrieval, while run, goal, queue, approval, and completion state remain outside Project Map authority.
deviations: Implemented only the helper operations required by the current vertical slice: read-set, api-context, and smoke-check.
The first verification attempt exposed an existing production-surface naming guard and one expected-order mismatch; both were corrected within allowed_files before the passing full rerun.
remaining_blockers: The local Kit has no explicit LICENSE/SPDX grant; provenance is recorded and no redistribution claim is made.
